# loading libraries

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggthemes)
library(stats)
library(forecast)
library(tseries)
library(formatR)
library(papaja)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)

```




# import data
```{r}
data<-read.csv("tsassign.csv")
head(data)
```



# structure
```{r}
str(data)
```



```{r}
temp_ts<-ts(data$Temperature,start=c(2024,1), end=c(2025,12),frequency=4 )
plot(temp_ts,main="Temperature trend", 
     col="green",

     )
```








```{r}
#Decompose time series data

#create a time series object

temp_ts<-ts(data$Temperature, frequency = 12, start = c(2024, 1))

# decompose time series

decomposed_hgh<-decompose(temp_ts)

# plot the decompostion

plot(decomposed_hgh)

```





```{r}
# Autocorrelation function

acf(temp_ts, lag.max=20)
```






```{r}
# partial autocorrelation of data

pacf(temp_ts, lag.max=20)
```






```{r}
# check stationality using (Augmented dickey Fuller test (ADF))

adf_reslt<-adf.test(temp_ts)  # if p-value<5%, the series is stationary

print(adf_reslt)

# series not stationary since p-value is greater than 5%



```





```{r}
# buid ana ARIMA model

# fit arim,a model

arima_model1<- auto.arima(temp_ts)
summary(arima_model1)
```







```{r}
# forecasting future format

forecast_arima1<- forecast(arima_model1, h=10)
head(forecast_arima1)
# forecast next 6 periods

plot(forecast_arima1)
```





```{r}
# if p-value> 5%, we take 2nd difference

diff2_hgh<-diff(temp_ts)

plot(diff2_hgh, main=" differenced time series data", col="red")
adf.test(diff2_hgh)
```
